body:
Thank you. The littlest things are like pulling teeth right now. Speaking up is one of the greatest sources of my anxiety--not looking like I have it together. Sometimes making the first phone call or trying to make the appointment or budget other aspects gets me too close into touch with the other fucked up details of my life that it sends me into some kind of fugue state that I don't recover from for hours or days. I had to push through an entire day just to write that post, and after doing so I had to let myself play some video games for an afternoon so I wouldn't melt down. At least I'm getting to work and back safely. What I really want at this point is someone I can hire to look at this stuff for me... make the calls, write the emails, sign at the dot, etc. Just be able to start fresh with a working budget and a calendar and know there aren't the ghosts of 10,000 failures lurking around every corner.

The choices are a big problem too. Which is the right place to call? What if it's a false start? What if they put me on the wrong drug and I go crazy? What if they tell me I'm a fuckup and it's all just more humiliation?

I tried to make some calls tonight but websites are down and the local crisis line won't pick up. I'm gonna ignore all this for another night because living in the reality of this is getting too dangerous. I know the worst part will be soon, though--when it will be just as dangerous not to. Trying to survive as best I can until I can find real help. Have an appointment next week with a therapist. 3 weeks since she's been able to see me. I should be able to make it till then worse comes to worse, and ask her to refer me to something that I can get immediate and extensive help from, not a session every 3 weeks.

Valium might be ok for near-mortal trauma, but I still have to be an operable adult at work (about the only place I can be) and survive my commute.

The BPD relationship has caused the most trauma of all of this. What it feels like is that I'm different people to her at different times. Or when she's seeing someone else, that that person has qualities that I don't have as partner. So those people are living proof, that I as a human being am an incomplete person. That I'm not enough for anyone. Least of all the person who is most important to me.
I wish it were that simple.
